panels.description: Solar uses EnergyPowerHoursByMinute where new Powerwall-era rows exist, with IotaWatt solar fallback for earlier dates.

targets.rawSql:
WITH new_daily AS (
  SELECT date(DateDTS) AS d, sum(SolarWh) AS wh
  FROM v_energy_power_energy_all
  WHERE $__timeFilter(DateDTS)
  GROUP BY 1
),
old_daily AS (
  SELECT date(DateDTS) AS d, sum(TotalSolarHours) AS wh
  FROM v_iotawatt_solar_energy_all
  WHERE $__timeFilter(DateDTS)
    AND date(DateDTS) NOT IN (SELECT d FROM new_daily)
  GROUP BY 1
),
daily AS (
  SELECT * FROM old_daily
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM new_daily
)
SELECT
  unix_timestamp(d) AS "time",
  sum(wh) over (order by d) as "Solar"
FROM daily
ORDER BY 1

panels.description: True home usage: EnergyPowerHoursByMinute.PanelUsageWh where non-null new rows exist, with IotaWatt panel usage fallback for earlier/solar-only backfilled dates. Battery charging is tracked separately.

targets.rawSql:
WITH new_daily AS (
  SELECT date(DateDTS) AS d, sum(PanelUsageWh) AS wh
  FROM v_energy_power_energy_all
  WHERE $__timeFilter(DateDTS)
    AND PanelUsageWh IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY 1
),
old_daily AS (
  SELECT date(DateDTS) AS d, sum(TotalWattHours) AS wh
  FROM v_iotawatt_energy_all
  WHERE $__timeFilter(DateDTS)
    AND date(DateDTS) NOT IN (SELECT d FROM new_daily)
  GROUP BY 1
),
daily AS (
  SELECT * FROM old_daily
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM new_daily
)
SELECT
  unix_timestamp(d) AS "time",
  sum(wh) over (order by d) as "Total"
FROM daily
ORDER BY 1

panels.description: Legacy IotaWatt circuit loads plus separate Powerwall battery charging/discharging series where new rows are available. Battery flow is not added to home usage.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  unix_timestamp(date(DateDts)) AS "time"

  ,sum(ACHours) as "AC"
  ,sum(DryerHours) as "Dryer"
  ,sum(RangeHours) as "Oven"
  ,sum(WaterHeaterHours) as "Water Heater"
  ,sum(EVHours) as "Tesla"
  ,sum(FurnaceHours) as "Furnace"
  ,sum(FridgeHours) as "Fridge"
  ,sum(KitchenHours) as "Kitchen"
  ,sum(AllOtherHours) as "All Other"
   
FROM v_iotawatt_energy_all
WHERE
  $__timeFilter(DateDTS)
Group by 1
ORDER BY unix_timestamp(DateDTS)

WITH new_daily AS (
  SELECT
    date(DateDTS) AS d,
    sum(HeatPumpWh) AS heatpump_wh,
    sum(BatteryChargingWh) AS battery_charging_wh,
    sum(CASE WHEN PowerwallOutWh > 0 THEN PowerwallOutWh ELSE 0 END) AS battery_discharging_wh
  FROM v_energy_power_energy_all
  WHERE $__timeFilter(DateDTS)
    AND (HeatPumpWh IS NOT NULL OR BatteryChargingWh IS NOT NULL OR PowerwallOutWh IS NOT NULL)
  GROUP BY 1
),
old_daily AS (
  SELECT
    date(DateDTS) AS d,
    sum(TotalHeatPumpHours) AS heatpump_wh,
    0 AS battery_charging_wh,
    0 AS battery_discharging_wh
  FROM v_iotawatt_solar_energy_all
  WHERE $__timeFilter(DateDTS)
    AND date(DateDTS) NOT IN (SELECT d FROM new_daily)
  GROUP BY 1
),
daily AS (
  SELECT * FROM old_daily
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM new_daily
)
SELECT
  unix_timestamp(d) AS "time",
  heatpump_wh as "HeatPump",
  battery_charging_wh as "Battery Charging",
  battery_discharging_wh as "Battery Discharging"
FROM daily
ORDER BY 1

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  unix_timestamp(date(StateStartTime)) AS "time",
sum(case when value='heating' then runtime/60 else null end) as "Heat Run Time",
sum(case when value='cooling' then runtime/60 else null end) as "A/C Run Time"
FROM thermostatcalc
WHERE
  $__timeFilter(StateStartTime)
Group by Date(StateStartTime)
ORDER BY StateStartTime

SELECT
  unix_timestamp(date(created)) AS "time"
  ,max(case when name='tempout' then vmax else null end) as 'Daily High'
  ,min(case when name='tempout' then vmin else null end) as 'Daily Low'
FROM (
  SELECT name, created, value AS vmin, value AS vmax, value AS vavg
    FROM weather WHERE $__timeFilter(created)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT name, bucket_start AS created, min_value AS vmin, max_value AS vmax, avg_value AS vavg
    FROM weather_hourly WHERE $__timeFilter(bucket_start)
) weather
where
name in ('tempout')
and
$__timeFilter(created)
Group by   unix_timestamp(date(created)) 
ORDER BY created

SELECT
  unix_timestamp(date(created)) AS "time"
  ,max(case when name='tempout' then vmax else null end) as 'Daily High'
  ,min(case when name='tempout' then vmin else null end) as 'Daily Low'

FROM (
  SELECT name, created, value AS vmin, value AS vmax, value AS vavg
    FROM weather WHERE $__timeFilter(created)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT name, bucket_start AS created, min_value AS vmin, max_value AS vmax, avg_value AS vavg
    FROM weather_hourly WHERE $__timeFilter(bucket_start)
) weather
where name='tempout'
and
  $__timeFilter(created)
Group by   unix_timestamp(date(created)) 
ORDER BY created

SELECT

  ,max(case when name='dailyRain' then vmax else null end) as 'Rain'
  ,max(case when name='windGust' then vmax else null end) as 'Wind'
  ,avg(case when name='humidityout' then vavg else null end) as 'Humidity'
FROM (
  SELECT name, created, value AS vmin, value AS vmax, value AS vavg
    FROM weather WHERE $__timeFilter(created)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT name, bucket_start AS created, min_value AS vmin, max_value AS vmax, avg_value AS vavg
    FROM weather_hourly WHERE $__timeFilter(bucket_start)
) weather
WHERE
  $__timeFilter(created)
Group by   unix_timestamp(date(created)) 
ORDER BY created

SELECT
 Unix_Timestamp(date(created)) AS "time"
,avg(case when displayName in ('Master bed motion sensor') then value else null end) as 'Upstairs'

,avg(case when displayName in ('Basement family motion','EcobeeSensor: Basement ecobee sensor (YBD6)') then value else null end) as 'Basement'

GROUP BY  Unix_Timestamp(date(created))
ORDER BY created
